label: caiso 35 reference seam
definition: caiso 35 reference-price seam: replaces the measured per-hub OASIS hub-LMP ladder (caiso_per_hub_intertie) with the forward-native reference-price seam (caiso_reference_price_seam) — both legs of each WECC corridor priced from (HH + gas_basis) x HR x load-shape +/- hurdle, CARB border carbon on import leg, export at hub - hurdle; HR anchors from measured Malin/Palo-Verde annual-mean RT LMP / delivered gas (derive_caiso_seam_hr_by_year.py; rule #11/#12); corridor ATC switched to the forward one-sided import envelope (caiso_corridor_atc_forward) so the export direction is free to the physical TTC. All other caiso 34 levers verbatim. Net-interchange error narrows to +3.56/+2.78/+4.40 TWh (2023/24/25, was chronically negative in prior keepers) and diurnal shape r improves to 0.88/0.93/0.89, confirming the seam correctly liberates midday solar export. However the CAISO price body-overprice is unchanged from caiso 34: CA-zone avg LMP ~100/63/69 vs actual ~44/33/34 (C3a +128%/+90%/+104%; C3b NRMSE 0.77/0.98/1.09; C3c scarcity hours 744/0/0 vs actual 21/35/8), and C6 governance gate is unattested (no calibration_attestation.json). Determination NOT-YET: failing C3a/C3b/C3c price-body gates and unattested C6.
